thread:
celeste: FYI planning to lift runtime pin for quant-optimized branch (runtime 4.2.0 -> 4.3.0) in the 01:00-02:00 UTC window. This enables quant allocator improvements and lower memory footprint for non-4bit models. Need SRE + ops signoff. Any red flags?
igor: allocator change previous minor caused an OOM on 8GB nodes in staging. Is this targeted at 8GB GPUs?
celeste: target cohort excludes 8GB nodes. We'll scope to >=16GB for this rollout. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with manual gates. Rollback triggers: OOMs>0.5% OR p95_increase>400ms sustained 5m.
mohammad: add gating for "quant/models!=q4_0"; we should avoid quantized model groups until we validate allocator behavior.
celeste: done. gating: "infra/gpu>=16GB" AND "quant/models!=q4_0". deploybot, schedule and enforce the gates.
deploybot: Scheduled for 01:05 UTC. Will run shadow warmup at 00:40 for 20m and enforce gates. Automated rollback configured.
sre-bot: preflight checks enabled: mem/leak-scan, kernel-selector sanity, and eviction-watch. Will report PASS/FAIL.
celeste: release note: one-liner about "improved allocator for non-4bit quant models" and a short rollback blurb. I'll draft in #release-notes.
ops: also add a flag to temporarily disable delayed-kv to isolate allocator path if we need to hotpatch.
igor: agreed. add runtime flag toggle `--allocator=legacy` for emergency.
deploybot: shadow warmup started 00:40 -> running long-seq samples.
sre-bot: shadow warmup PASS at 01:02 UTC. No obvious leaks on 16GB cohort. Gates clear.
deploybot: Canary started 01:06 -> 5% routing. Metrics: latency flat, no OOMs. Advancing to 20% at 01:14.
mohammad: seeing an uptick in evictions on dedicated pools in us-west-2 after the 20% bump. Small absolute numbers but noticeable.
sre-bot: detected ephemeral OOMs on 3 nodes in dedicated pool (eviction count=3). Alerting SRE.
igor: if evictions from allocator mismatch, prefer pin-back. Can we toggle `--allocator=legacy` remotely while rolling?
celeste: we have the flag ready but prefer rollback first to avoid partial surface changes.
deploybot: HOLD requested by @igor. Holding at 20%.
ops: traces show GC-like stalls then OOM on qemu-worker process; looks allocator-related and concentrated on one driver version.
mohammad: driver mismatch with older CUDA driver on dedicated hosts. This cohort slipped past the >=16GB filter because host images are heterogeneous.
celeste: decision: rollback to 4.2.0 across all affected nodes. deploybot, execute rollback and reapply pin.
deploybot: Executing rollback -> applying runtime pin=4.2.0. Command: `deploybot rollback --target runtime=4.2.0 --reason "dedicated pool evictions us-west-2"`.
deploybot: Rollback complete at 01:32 UTC. Runtime pinned back to 4.2.0. Notifying oncall and opening incident ticket.
sre-bot: Incident #2118 opened: "allocator-triggered evictions on dedicated pool". Captured traces and host driver versions.
igor: action items: (1) add driver-version gating to cohort selection, (2) add allocator legacy flag as quick toggle in deploy runbook, (3) schedule a dedicated-pool smoke with driver matrix.
celeste: I'll update release notes: "unpin attempt aborted; rollback performed due to evictions on dedicated hosts; next attempt will include driver gating and emergency allocator toggle." Also drafting a short postmortem.
mohammad: +1. Tag me for rerun test.
celeste: thanks everyone. Closing this thread; follow-ups in #release-notes and incident #2118. :thumbsup:
